name: manifest-dev
description: Manifest-driven workflows: /define writes a verifiable Manifest, /do executes it, /ticket-up authors coherent Ticket units, /run-ticket recovers and lands one exact Ticket, and /sweep-tickets advances one Auto Ticket per scheduled invocation. /design-v2 adds reference-calibrated HTML-first design with purpose-aware aliveness, using the shared design implementation and verification discipline.
